title: Executor settings
description: settings.json: the tab's and its server's settings (docs/executor/Settings.md). The one source of defaults, types, ranges, labels and help: tools/standalone validates with it, settings.js makes the dialog from it. x-scope: page (the tab's) or server (tools/standalone's own). x-apply: live, executor (Executor restarts to apply), server (at the server's next start). x-choices: options the page fills in (systems: disk images; screens).

system.title: System
system.description: The System the Mac starts: Apple's, from one of your disks, or Executor's own.

ram_mb.title: Memory
ram_mb.description: Auto: 32 MB for Executor's System, 128 MB for Apple's.

screen.title: Screen size
screen.description: Width × height, in Mac pixels. Custom… for any other size.

depth.title: Colours
depth.description: How many colours the screen starts with (Auto: millions on Mac OS 8 and 9, 256 on System 7). Some games need 256.

ppc.title: PowerPC
ppc.description: Run the PowerPC code in applications that have both kinds (PowerPC-only ones always run it).

disks.title: Disks
disks.description: Disk images from the library and your own. Your changes are saved separately; the image itself is never changed.

mounted.title: Library disks
mounted.description: Library disks in the Mac, in this order. Each is downloaded once and kept in this browser.

images.title: Library folder
images.description: Where the server finds its disk images (empty: DATA/images).

include.title: Include
include.description: File name patterns to offer in the library.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: File name patterns to leave out.

max_image_mb.title: Largest disk image you can upload (MB)

command_key.title: Command key
command_key.description: The key that acts as the Mac's Command (⌘) key. The browser keeps some Ctrl shortcuts (Ctrl+W, Ctrl+T) unless the keyboard is captured.
x-labels: Meta (⌘ / Windows key) — Alt is Option, Ctrl is Control
Ctrl — Alt is Option, Meta is Control
Alt — Meta is Option, Ctrl is Control

keyboard_capture.title: Capture the keyboard in fullscreen
keyboard_capture.description: In fullscreen, all keys go to the Mac, browser shortcuts too. Chrome and Edge only; hold Esc to leave.

right_click.title: Right button
right_click.description: What the right mouse button does.

wheel_scroll.title: Scroll wheel scrolls the window under the pointer
wheel_scroll.description: The wheel scrolls the Mac window under the pointer by clicking its scroll bar (the Mac had no scroll wheel).

display.title: Display
display.description: How the Mac's screen is shown.

scale.title: Sharpness
scale.description: Draw the screen this many times larger, with smooth text (Auto: as sharp as your display). Programs still see the same screen size.

smoothing.title: Smooth scaling
smoothing.description: Blend pixels when the screen is enlarged (off: sharp pixels).

fullscreen_button.title: Fullscreen button
fullscreen_button.description: Show a Fullscreen button in the bar (F11 also works).

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: The Mac's sound, played by the browser.

enabled.title: Sound
enabled.description: Play the Mac's sound (it starts after your first click or key).

network.title: Network
network.description: Who can reach the server, and the Mac's Internet access through it.

bind.title: Listen on
bind.description: 127.0.0.1: this computer only. 0.0.0.0: other computers on your network too (use TLS). The first browser to open the page keeps it until the server restarts.

port.title: Port
port.description: Auto: any free port (the server prints which).

relay_enabled.title: Internet for the Mac
relay_enabled.description: Let the Mac's network software (MacTCP, Open Transport) reach the Internet through the server.

relay_ports.title: Allowed ports
relay_ports.description: Ports the Mac may connect to: numbers and ranges like 8000-8080.

relay_allow_private.title: Local network
relay_allow_private.description: Also allow this computer and your local network.

relay_max_sockets.title: Connections
relay_max_sockets.description: At most this many open at once, for all tabs together.

relay_max_connections.title: Tabs
relay_max_connections.description: At most this many tabs using the Internet at once.

relay_nameserver.title: Name server
relay_nameserver.description: DNS server for the Mac's lookups (empty: this computer's).

trusted_proxies.title: Trusted proxies
trusted_proxies.description: Proxy addresses whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted.

secure_cookies.title: Secure cookies
secure_cookies.description: Auto: when the page is served over HTTPS (here or by a trusted proxy).

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: PEM certificate file for HTTPS. auto: make a self-signed one; empty: plain HTTP.

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Its private key file (empty: in the certificate file).

max_upload_mb.title: Largest request (MB)
max_upload_mb.description: The most one request may send to the server, such as your saved disk changes. Disk image uploads have their own limit (Disks).

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Logging and debugging. The page's messages also go to the server's log.

logtraps.title: Log Toolbox calls
logtraps.description: Names to log, comma-separated (wildcards; -NAME leaves one out; 1: all). Empty: none.

logtraps_nesting.title: Nested calls
logtraps_nesting.description: Also log calls made this deep inside Toolbox callbacks.

screenshot_button.title: Screenshot button
screenshot_button.description: Show a Screenshot button in the bar (it saves the screen to the server's log).

data.title: Data folder
data.description: Where settings, your disk changes, Executor's files and the logs are kept (--data).
